games.description: A brief failed launch attempt with APL. Sark tries the menus and connection options, but freezing and crashes stop them before any match gameplay.
games.title: Down to One

games.description: A solo search through the hospital for Auggie, followed by repeated short runs through the available chapters. Sark experiments with skips and glow-stick routes before celebrating his fastest attempt.
games.title: Ending Way

games.description: Co-op ghost investigations with APL Fisher. The pair learn the equipment and mission guide, restore power, chase notebook and axe clues, get stuck on a hammer pickup, then restart for a bone hunt that ends amid inventory and synchronization problems.
games.title: Friki

games.description: Two visits to the haunted village. Sark and APL Fisher first struggle with the equipment and deaths, then return with Bruce Greene and Diction for the orphanage clues, portals and final altar objective.
games.title: Haunt Chaser

games.description: A solo escape from the generator maze. Sark works out the routes, repeatedly evades the pursuing creature with boxes and loops, activates the generators, and finally reaches the exit.
games.title: Horror Maze

games.description: Sark and APL navigate a dark building full of locked doors, hostile creatures and collection puzzles. They repair pipes, guide each other through a blind room and work through shapes and skulls before the final number puzzle.
games.title: Somewhere in the Shadow

games.description: An abandoned town, a riddling stranger and monsters that punish looking away give Sark and his partners a difficult co-op escape. A short attempt with Diction is followed by a much longer return with APL through the compass search and later challenges.
games.title: Stay Close
